Great — here is a comprehensive overview of the hotel brands most commonly considered by owners in the Caribbean and Latin America (CALA) who want brand affiliation while preserving greater hotel individuality. These are known as **"soft brands"** or **"soft brand collections."**

---

## Soft Brand Collections Commonly Considered by Hotel Owners in the Caribbean & Latin America

content.text: Soft brand hotels provide a distinctive blend of autonomy and brand affiliation, enabling individual properties to retain their unique character and identity while leveraging the advantages of a larger hotel brand's resources, marketing capabilities, and loyalty programs.

Below are the key brands active in the CALA region:

---

**Autograph Collection** is one of the most active soft brands in the CALA region.

With nearly 40 open hotels and a strong pipeline of 13 properties under development, owners and franchisees across the region appreciate the brand's flexibility — from locally curated collections to all-inclusive resorts — all while affiliating with Marriott's global hospitality platform.

content.text: Wyndham has two soft brands: The Registry Collection, which is in the luxury space, and Trademark by Wyndham, which exists in the upper midscale/upscale space. Registry's more than 20 resorts — more than half of which are Grand Palladium properties — reside outside of the United States.

This makes the Registry Collection particularly relevant in CALA, where large resort properties are prevalent.

In short,

citations.cited_text: Over the past decade, Marriott, Hilton, Hyatt, IHG and Accor have all expanded their soft brand portfolios, creating collections designed to attract i...
citations.title: What Are Soft Brands in Hospitality? Why Hotel Owners Are Embracing a New Branding Model – Hotel Magazine

content.text: Marriott, Hilton, Hyatt, IHG, and Accor have all expanded their soft brand portfolios over the past decade, creating collections designed to attract independent hotels that might never have considered a traditional brand affiliation.

For CALA owners in particular, **Marriott's Autograph Collection and Tribute Portfolio**, **IHG's Vignette Collection**, and **Hilton's Curio Collection** are among the most actively pursued options, alongside the longstanding independent consortia.
